comments.body: where do u get this outfit

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This outfit is dropped (somewhat rarely) by the following Ganador:

Effingam

As all Ganadors are unique to certain time periods and possess strong battle skills, this may be more difficult for some to accomplish than others. Stats:

Gunnery +2
Evasion +2
Reloading +1
Unisex, 50k total fame to equip.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Ganador%2FList
